integrity: Proof gives complete elementary finite-lattice and contraction/similarity analysis; finite rational verification is corroboration, not proof of infinite behavior.
scientific_limitations: Exact 1D two-component equal-curvature constant-step problem, epoch endpoints from zero; general optimizer-exclusion phenomenon not established for other objectives, initialization, and averaged iterates. Classic Bernoulli convolution facts are known; independent novelty confirmation outstanding.
title: A sharp optimizer-exclusion frontier for random reshuffling despite smaller mean-square error
